name: godot-mcp
description: A small, security-first Godot MCP server for Claude Code: an editor plugin (loopback port, per-session token) and a Python stdlib stdio server. Eight tools: status, run and stop a scene, read game and editor output, scene tree, add a node and set a property (both undoable), save the open scene. Read-only switch on both sides; nothing deletes, writes other files or runs code sent to it. Installs nothing.
